formats.qualification: Real projected NOAA HRRR GRIB2 decoded and authored to native HDF; native HEC-RAS preprocessing not yet qualified
formats.notes: The opt-in live test filters APCP from NOAA NOMADS, selects an explicit GRIB message, validates a positive precipitation cube, and verifies native HDF authoring. Do not infer that every GDAL-readable encoding works in HEC-RAS. WPC QPF GRIB2 compression is a documented exception through 7.0.1.
HEC documents HEC-MetVue or HEC-Vortex as the workaround through 7.0.1.

formats.vendor_route: ras-commander translation to NetCDF plus native HDF materialization
formats.qualification: Supported with translation; qualified on Windows and CLB07/Wine 11 with HEC-RAS 6.6
formats.notes: Explicit timestamps, units, temporal semantics, CRS, affine grid, and NoData policy are validated before a content-addressed HEC-compatible NetCDF and equivalent HDF payload are written. Windows and Wine qualifications verified temporary-HDF rainfall, completed compute, and positive final per-cell rainfall and hydraulics. HEC-RAS documentation examined for 6.0-7.0.1 limits native GDAL meteorological precipitation to NetCDF or GRIB; direct vendor GeoTIFF ingestion and cross-version support are not claimed.
This is the solver-facing representation authored by RAS Mapper and ras-commander, not an independently advertised external format.
